title: Crystal structure preparation
action: Prepare DFT input files for BaFe2As2 (space group I4/mmm, a=3.9090 Å, c=13.2122 Å, atomic positions: Ba (0,0,0), Fe (0.5,0,0.25), As (0,0,0.3538)) and LaOFeAs (space group P4/nmm, a=4.03533 Å, c=8.74090 Å, atomic positions: La (0.25,0.25,0.14154), Fe (0.75,0.25,0.5), As (0.25,0.25,0.6512), O (0.75,0.25,0)).
description: Generate input files for DFT calculations with correct crystal structures.

title: LDA self-consistent field calculations
action: Run density functional theory (DFT) LDA self-consistent field calculations for both BaFe2As2 and LaOFeAs using an open-source DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO), to obtain converged charge density and Kohn-Sham eigenvalues.
description: Perform SCF calculations to produce the electronic ground state.

title: Density of states for BaFe2As2
action: Compute total and Fe-d partial density of states for BaFe2As2 from the SCF eigenvalues, using a dense k-point mesh and appropriate smearing. Save to dos_BaFe2As2.dat.
description: DOS data for BaFe2As2, with columns: energy (eV), total DOS (states/eV/cell), and Fe-d partial DOS (states/eV/cell).

title: Density of states for LaOFeAs
action: Compute total and Fe-d partial density of states for LaOFeAs analogously to step 3. Save to dos_LaOFeAs.dat.
description: DOS data for LaOFeAs, same format.

title: Band structure for BaFe2As2
action: Compute energy eigenvalues along a high-symmetry k-path for the tetragonal Brillouin zone of BaFe2As2 (e.g., Γ-X-M-Γ-Z). Write bands_BaFe2As2.dat with one line per k-point per band containing kx, ky, kz (in units of 2π/a), band index (integer), and eigenvalue (eV).
output_schema: Columns: kx, ky, kz (2π/a), band_index (integer), eigenvalue (eV)

title: Band structure for LaOFeAs
action: Compute band structure for LaOFeAs analogously, using an appropriate high-symmetry path (e.g., Γ-X-M-Γ-Z). Save to bands_LaOFeAs.dat.
output_schema: Columns: kx, ky, kz (2π/a), band_index (integer), eigenvalue (eV)

title: Fermi surface topology analysis
action: From the band structure data, determine for each compound the number of hole-like bands crossing the Fermi level at the Γ point and the number of electron-like bands at the X point. Write a text file fermi_surface_topology.txt with these counts.
description: Fermi surface topology summary: number of hole bands at Γ and electron bands at X.
output_schema: Text: for each compound, lines 'holes_at_Gamma: N', 'electrons_at_X: M'.

title: Fe-d bandwidth comparison
action: From the Fe-d partial density of states data in dos_BaFe2As2.dat and dos_LaOFeAs.dat, compute the Fe-d bandwidth for each compound (defined as the energy range where Fe-d DOS exceeds 10% of its maximum value). Write bandwidth_comparison.txt containing the bandwidth values and their difference.
description: Computed Fe-d bandwidth difference for both compounds.
output_schema: Text: lines 'BaFe2As2 bandwidth: X.XX eV', 'LaOFeAs bandwidth: Y.YY eV', 'Difference: Z.ZZ eV'.
